note: R68-diag2: cut the IfRegion else-arm block sequence at the first block joined from outside region.blocks, so statements that merely lie past the enclosing if/else merge are re-emitted by the parent sequence instead of being hoisted into this else arm. Witness: synth/r68d2_else_join.pyc and site-packages/IQEngine/plugins/plugin_system_matcher/matcher.pyc::match.
